name: Interactive Hover Grid
description: Full-screen grid of dark cells with a soft blurred glow that trails the cursor underneath, shining through the gaps and through transparent reveal cells that show a short text.
contents: Grid of rows by columns opaque cells
Blurred radial glow following the pointer
behavior: Glow follows the pointer with smooth lerped easing via requestAnimationFrame
Glow is visible through the 2px gaps and transparent cells
Uses pointer events so touch drag also moves the glow
editableByProps: Grid size, which cells are transparent, and their text
Cell, background and glow colors, glow size and follow speed

needsCodeEdit.where: blur-[70px] class on the glow div
gap-[2px] class on the grid div

fixed: Glow position is tracked from window pointer events, so it follows the pointer anywhere on the page
Root is at least the viewport height
